title: 18 Weeks of Building My Own Browser MMORPG - New Endgame Zone, Pets, World Boss & More
author: Big-Sandwich733
selftext:
Hey everyone!

It's been a while since my last update on my browser MMORPG, Lythravel.

I've been working on the game for about 18 weeks now as a solo developer with the help of AI, and I'm trying to build at least a small community of players around it.

One thing that really helped recently was a YouTuber who featured Lythravel in one of his videos. This brought quite a few new players to the game, and some of them are still playing today and giving me valuable feedback on PvP, class balance, and other mechanics.

It also made me realize just how much work there is still to do in this area. So that's basically what I've been "enjoying" over the past few weeks, working together with players to get PvP balance into a somewhat reasonable state. :D

From my perspective, balancing PvP is probably the hardest part of the entire development process so far.

Meanwhile, I've also added quite a bit of new content, including fishing and a new endgame zone.

The new zone is an island where players can complete a questline to obtain a pet that follows them around and helps collect loot. There's also a world boss that players from both factions can fight over. The entire island is a PvP zone, so encounters with enemy players are always a possibility.

You can see more of it in the video.

A little about the AI side of development:

I'm mainly using Claude Code and gpt image gen for references for assets for the game. AI makes it possible for me to work on a project of this scale as a solo developer, but there's still a lot of testing, tweaking, and decision-making involved, especially when it comes to gameplay balance.

If you'd like to try Lythravel, you can play completely free in your browser:

[https://lythravel.com/](https://lythravel.com/)

There's also a downloadable Windows version available.

I'd really appreciate any feedback! :)
